cohort: 600 nulliparous women admitted for labor at Kasr Al Ainy hospital in Cairo, Egypt, between February 2016 and February 2017.
finding: Obese women had a lower rate of cervical dilatation, longer labor duration, higher incidence of intrapartum cesarean delivery, and higher neonatal birth weight compared to normal weight and underweight women.
mod_finding: The incidence of intrapartum cesarean delivery was highest in the obese group (P<0.001).
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight was highest in the obese group (P<0.001).
